questions.prompt: Name something Allah swears by in the Qur'an ("By the …").

answers.explanation: "By the sun and its brightness."
"By time, mankind is in loss" — Surah al-'Asr.
"By the moon when it follows the sun."
"By the night when it covers."
"By the dawn, and ten nights."
"By the morning brightness" — Surah ad-Duha.
"By the fig and the olive" — Surah at-Tin.
"By Mount Sinai" — and "By the Mount" in Surah at-Tur.
Makkah — "By this secure city."
"By the Qur'an, full of wisdom."
"By the day when it appears."
"Nun. By the pen and what they write."
"By the star when it falls", and by the positions of the stars.
"By the sky with its great constellations."
"By the earth and Him who spread it."
"By the soul and Him who proportioned it."
"I swear by the Day of Resurrection."
"And I swear by the self-reproaching soul."
"By the dawn, and ten nights."
"By the even and the odd."
"By the racers, panting" — Surah al-'Adiyat.
"By the winds that scatter" — Surah adh-Dhariyat.
"By those who pull out harshly" — the angels of Surah an-Nazi'at.
"And by the father and what he fathered."
"I swear by the twilight glow."
"By the sea filled with fire."
"By the House that is frequented" — al-Bayt al-Ma'mur.
"By a Book inscribed in parchment unrolled."

variants: Lord of the heavens and earth
answers.explanation: "By your Lord, they will not believe until…"
"By your life" — Allah swears by the life of the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.prompt: Name one of the major sins in Islam.

answers.explanation: Associating partners with Allah — the gravest sin.
Killing a soul that Allah has made sacred.
Adultery and fornication.
Wine and intoxicants are 'filth from the work of Shaytan'.
Stealing.
Taking or consuming interest.
Practising sorcery.
Being undutiful to one's parents.
Bearing false witness.
Unjustly taking what belongs to orphans.
Accusing chaste, innocent believing women.
Games of chance — 'filth from the work of Shaytan'.
Leaving the obligatory prayers.
Speaking ill of someone behind their back.
answers.note: Many scholars count it among the major sins.

answers.explanation: Running away from the army when facing the enemy.
Breaking off relations with relatives.
Taking one's own life.
"No one with an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will enter Paradise."
Giving short measure and weight.
Giving or taking bribes.
Habitual lying, and especially lying about Allah and His Messenger ﷺ.
answers.note: Al-Dhahabi lists persistent lying among the major sins.
